objective: Commander Althea Ebonlocke of Darkshire wants you to kill 20 Plague Spreaders in the eastern Raven Hill mausoleum.

description: The situation in Raven Hill is still grim.  The safety of Darkshire is in your hands, <name>.  I don't have enough Watchers to keep the town safe.  We need you to dispatch for Raven Hill yet again and rid the eastern mausoleum of 20 Plague Spreaders!
progress: I need your assistance, <name>. Travel to the cemetery to the northwest and rid the eastern mausoleum of 20 Plague Spreaders.
Return to me when your task is complete.
completion: On behalf of the people of Darkshire and as the Leader of the Night Watch, I thank you, <name>, for your bravery and dedication. May the Light shine upon your ways.
